h1: Custom Direct to Film T Shirts
metaTitle: Custom Direct to Film T Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom direct to film t shirts for your team or event. Vibrant prints, bulk pricing, fast turnaround at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Direct to film (DTF) printing offers vivid, durable graphics on custom t shirts without the limitations of traditional screen printing. This method works on cotton, polyester, and blends, making it ideal for uniforms, event giveaways, or promotional apparel. DTF transfers produce soft-hand prints with excellent wash durability, even on dark fabrics. Whether you need full-color logos or intricate designs, DTF delivers consistent results for bulk orders.
heroAltText: Custom direct to film t shirts with vibrant full-color print on dark fabric
